parameters.name: accessLevel
parameters.description:
Returns only organizations where the user has the specified access level.

- 5: external member

- 15: member

- 60: administrator

- 70: owner

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This parameter is not required when authenticating with an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or Security Token Service (STS).

parameters.name: minAccessLevel
parameters.description:
Returns only organizations where the user's access level is greater than or equal to the specified value.

- 5: external member

- 15: member

- 60: administrator

- 70: owner

> If specified, `minAccessLevel` takes precedence over `accessLevel`.
